rubrics.evidence: The agent's patch only extracts cssModules.ts and hotReload.ts back into separate modules. The descriptor cache and parsing remain as static members of the SFCLoader class inside index.ts (the entry): `static descriptorCache = new Map<string, SFCDescriptor>()`, `static setDescriptor(...)`, `static getDescriptor(...)`, and `private static cleanQuery(...)` are all still defined in index.ts.
